name: Armor
description: A set of up to four armor pieces sharing one material.

fields.label: Include helmet
fields.help: Generate the helmet item.

fields.label: Item texture
fields.help: Inventory icon of the helmet.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: Display name of the helmet.

fields.label: Worn model
fields.help: Java entity model drawn when worn; "Default" uses the vanilla armor shape.

fields.label: Model part: helmet
fields.help: Name of the custom model part attached to this body part.

fields.label: Translucent model
fields.help: Render the custom worn model with transparency.

fields.label: Model texture
fields.help: Texture for the custom worn model; empty reuses the armor layer texture.

fields.label: Item model type
fields.help: Kind of model used for the item in hand and inventory.

fields.label: Item model
fields.help: "Normal" or "Tool" for built-in shapes, otherwise a JSON or OBJ model.

fields.label: Fireproof
fields.help: Dropped item does not burn in fire or lava.

fields.label: Enchanted glint
fields.help: Always show the enchantment glint.

fields.label: Glint condition
fields.help: Optional procedure deciding when the glint shows.

fields.label: Tooltip lines
fields.help: Extra tooltip lines under the name, one per row.

fields.label: Tooltip lines procedure
fields.help: Optional procedure that returns the tooltip lines instead of the fixed list.

fields.label: Keeps piglins calm
fields.help: Piglins stay neutral while this piece is worn, like gold armor.

fields.label: Piglin neutral condition
fields.help: Optional procedure deciding when piglins stay neutral.

fields.label: Armor layer texture
fields.help: Texture pair (layer 1 for head, chest and feet; layer 2 for legs) drawn on the player.

fields.label: Rarity
fields.help: Color of the item name.

fields.label: Creative tabs
fields.help: Creative inventory tabs that list this element. Tabs defined in this mod are offered as well.

fields.label: Equip sound
fields.help: Sound played when a piece is put on. Leave empty for the default.

fields.label: Durability factor
fields.help: Multiplied by a per-slot base to get each piece's durability.

fields.label: Enchantability
fields.help: How good the enchantments rolled on an enchanting table are.

fields.label: Toughness
fields.help: Reduces damage from strong hits.

fields.label: Knockback resistance
fields.help: Share of knockback ignored per piece (0.1 = 10%).

fields.label: Repair items
fields.help: Items (or tags) that repair the armor in an anvil.

fields.label: Attribute modifiers
fields.help: Attribute changes applied while the selected pieces are worn.

fields.label: Slot
fields.help: Slot the modifier is tied to.

fields.label: Operation
fields.help: How the amount is applied to the attribute.

fields.label: Pieces
fields.help: Armor pieces that carry this modifier.

fields.label: Helmet tick
fields.help: Runs every tick while the helmet is worn.

fields.label: Chestplate tick
fields.help: Runs every tick while the chestplate is worn.

fields.label: Leggings tick
fields.help: Runs every tick while the leggings are worn.

fields.label: Boots tick
fields.help: Runs every tick while the boots are worn.
